fusions.name: Split at the Junction
fusions.desc: Sends a rat at the first enemy in line, where it deals 4 damage, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Both Tunnels at Once
fusions.desc: Two rats burst out on diverging paths, each dealing 11 damage and stunning what it hits for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ambush at Every Turn
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to plant a rat nest on the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and deals 14 damage in a blast 2.5 tiles across to the first 2 enemies that come within 2.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Other Way Round
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
